preview: Dhruv Kunjadiya shares his internship interview experience at Morgan Stanley, detailing the technical and HR rounds, coding questions, and preparation resources.
content: Morgan Stanley Interview Experience - Dhruv Kunjadiya (TY B.Tech- CS) Round 1 : I was advanced to Round 2 based on my performance in MS-Code-to-give hackathon. Round 2 : Technical Round ( 1st August, 2022 at 9:15 AM. Lasted for 1 Hr 20 mins ) ● I was asked to introduce myself(prepare a good introduction of yourself before the interview as it is obvious question) ● Then I was asked about which language I am comfortable.I told them C++. Then he asked whether I knew C. I said yes. He asked about struct keyword in C. He continued the question by asking when you will use a structure and when a Class. What is the advantage of using class? ● Further I was asked about OOP. Tell the main pillars of OOP. Then he took paper and wrote two classes. Base class and derived class. Then he made a base class pointer and it was a pointing derived class. “Show” method was there in both classes. He asked whether the base class show will be called or derived?.I told the base class. He asked if I wanted to call the derived method then?. I said we will use virtual keyword. He told me to write it on paper where I will write virtual. Then he asked what if I make a derived class pointer?. I said derived class pointer can only call derived class methods. Then he asked me about friend function. ● Then the second interviewer asked me a coding qn. I was given numbers from 1-100 and only one number was missing, except that all numbers were present. I told them we will find the sum of the given numbers and subtract it from the total sum. I was told to write code on paper. Then she asked me T.C . ● Based on my code I had used vector so I was asked about the difference between arrays and vectors. I was further told that a certain point v.push_back() is giving error(not a logical error). What could be the error? I told memory overflow. But he said memory is still available. I said the heap memory would be full. He said no. He asked how data in a vector is stored. I said contiguous. Then he gave me a hint about what you do when in arrays allocated size is fully used. I told we make a bigger size array and copy our existing array. Then I got that If no contiguous free space is available then this error will come. I told this and then he asked how can we solve this? I told about Linked list. I was then asked about segmentation. ● Now I was asked a 2nd coding question. I was asked about LRU cache. I was given some numbers and when a no is not present it will be added to cache. If it is already present then It will become recently used. Extra constraint was I was given limited size, if size becomes full then delete least recently used and add new element(new element will become recently used). I was told to do the get() operation in O(1) time. I already knew this question. We will use unordered_map and doubly linked list. I was told to write the code. ● Then I was asked about one of my projects. I explained them. Seeing the concepts used in the project he asked me about a Concrete class 🙂. I was not able to answer this. Then he asked me about abstract classes in C++. Second interviewer then asked me about techstack used in one of my projects. ● At the end I was asked If I had any questions for them? I asked about what type of projects are given to interns. Can you give an example project given to an intern?(Always ask questions, It shows your interest towards them) ● After this round 11 were shortlisted for Round 3. I was one of them. Round 3 : HR Round ( 1st August, 2022 at 3 PM. Lasted for 40 mins) ● I was asked to introduce myself. Then he asked me about my hobbies. Based on my answer I was asked about any responsibilities/roles I hold. ● I was asked about what is leadership in my views , further I was asked about If I had 2 projects , one is fancy looking and other has some low-level work. Which one I will select and how will I convince my friends to choose that project. I was then asked about how tech has helped people in rural areas, give an example? ● Further I was asked how much of a risk taking person you are, reasons for that. Then he asked why 90% startups fail in India. I was asked about Why you want to join MS. My views about MS. He asked about my views about diversity. ● I was asked if one person has a skill set of 9/10 and he belongs to a similar culture as mine and another has a skill set of 8/10 and he belongs to a different culture. Whom will you select and why? ● I was asked to explain about one of my projects. I was asked what motivates you to do projects. I was asked whether I know about upi, stock market. He asked me how do you convince a person , In a meeting of people you take the lead and give suggestions? ● Then at the end he asked whether I had any qns for him? I asked about work culture at MS?. On 8th August, 2022, 8 candidates were offered internship and I was lucky to be one of them. Resources ( Referred by me ) : ● Leetcode practice sheet ● Love Babbar 450 DSA sheet ● Love Babbar OOPS sheet ● Love Babbar DBMS sheet ● Love Babbar OS sheet ● Operating System video explanation by Gate smashers ● Interview Bit HR questions ● System Design Tips for interviews : ● Be confident throughout the interview. It is okay if you don't get some questions. ● Think out loud whatever you are thinking. Don’t make any assumptions. Always ask the interviewer. ● While explaining interviewer give examples to make things clear. If you don’t know something, simply tell the interviewer about it. Never cheat on your resume. ● How you think and try in front of the interviewer matters, be confident and everything will go in place. BEST OF LUCK !!
